entities.name: Meir ben Ezekiel ibn Gabbai
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Meir ben Ezekiel ibn Gabbai was a Kabbalist born in Spain toward the end of 1480. While the details of his life are not known, he likely lived in Turkey and possibly died in the Land of Israel.
